note: The cited identity is Bombieri's at `β = 0`; Lean proves it for every shift `β`, indexed by characters mod a common `L` with weight `w(q,cond)`, instead of primitive characters mod `q*`.

snippet.text:
/-- **Bombieri's identity, lifted to a common modulus `L`**: for `q ∣ L` and `aₙ` supported on
`n` coprime to `L`,
`φ(q) Σ_{b unit mod q} |S(b/q + β)|² = Σ_{Ψ mod L, cond Ψ ∣ q} w(q, cond Ψ) |S_{Ψ⁻¹}(β)|²`. -/
theorem totient_mul_sum_units_lift {q L : ℕ} [NeZero q] [NeZero L] (hqL : q ∣ L) {a : ℕ → ℂ}
    (ha : Summable fun n => ‖a n‖) (hcop : ∀ n, a n ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime n L) (β : ℝ) :
    q.totient * ∑ b ∈ (univ : Finset (ZMod q)).filter IsUnit, ‖expTsum a ((b.val : ℝ) / q + β)‖ ^ 2 =
      ∑ Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ L,

proof_context.conclusion: For `q ∣ L` and `aₙ` supported coprime to `L`, `φ(q) Σ_{b unit mod q} |S(b/q+β)|² = Σ_{Ψ mod L, cond Ψ ∣ q} w(q,cond Ψ) |S_{Ψ⁻¹}(β)|²` with `w(q,c)=c` when `q/c` squarefree and coprime to `c`, else 0.
